age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

checks_failed.description: Reads that failed, each leaving the offers it affects with funded_ratio (or expired) null: `account`, `lines`, `issuer:<address>`, `ledger`, `reserves`; empty when none failed

marker.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (send as `marker`); null on the last page

offers.description: Open DEX offers of this page, in the ledger's order

buys.description: What the offer buys (TakerPays); XRP in XRP, not drops

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

expired.description: True when the Expiration is at or before the validated ledger close time; false without an Expiration; null when that close time could not be read

expires_at.description: Expiration of the offer, ISO 8601 UTC; null when the offer has none

funded_ratio.description: min(1, available / sells), per offer (offers sharing a balance are not netted): available is spendable XRP (balance minus reserve) for XRP, or the line balance divided by the issuer TransferRate / 1e9 for a token; 1 when the account issues the token it sells; 0 when the issuer froze the line or all its tokens, when the line of the bought token is deep-frozen by its issuer, or when a complete lines page holds no line for the token; null for an MPT, when the line may lie beyond the lines page read, when the issuer is beyond the first 10 distinct issuers of the page, or when a read it needs failed (see checks_failed)

passive.description: lsfPassive: the offer does not consume offers that exactly match it

price.description: buys.value / sells.value; null when sells is zero

sell.description: lsfSell: the offer exchanges all of sells even when it gets more than buys

sells.description: What the offer sells (TakerGets); XRP in XRP, not drops

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

seq.description: Sequence number of the transaction that created the offer

unfunded.description: Offers on this page with funded_ratio 0

description: One page of an account's open DEX offers, with how funded each one is. When to use: To see which DEX offers an account has open and whether each can still execute: before cancelling or replacing offers, or to check how much of an account's open offers its balances back. Prefer another tool: To read the order book of a pair (use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook`) or estimate the cost of a trade (use `/v1/xrpl/slippage`); for the account's balances and trust lines, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary` or `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`. Example: xrpl_account_offers {"address":"rGAs3npYy1VwLPE92kvKvA2QYLR6FSA9n6"} Credits only: paid by prepaid credit, 0.0025 EUR or 0.003 USD units per call; buy a bundle first at https://api.criptonlabs.com/v1/pro/credits/{bundle} or with `credits_topup`, then call with the `clc_` token or Sign-In-With-X.

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

limit.description: Offers per page: an integer from 10 to 50 (default 20)

marker.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `marker`, for the same address

name: xrpl_account_offers
